questions.question_text: What is the main difference between competitive and collaborative negotiation?

options.text: Competitive focuses on mutual gain, while collaborative focuses on winning at all costs
Competitive is about one side winning, while collaborative aims for both sides to benefit
Competitive builds long-term relationships, while collaborative is for one-time deals
Competitive involves teamwork, while collaborative involves hiding information

correct_answer.text: Competitive is about one side winning, while collaborative aims for both sides to benefit

questions.question_text: Why is it important to identify your interests before a negotiation?

options.text: It helps you hide your true goals from the other party
It allows you to focus on the deeper reasons behind what you want and find flexible solutions
It ensures you always get exactly what you ask for without compromise
It makes the other party agree with you immediately

correct_answer.text: It allows you to focus on the deeper reasons behind what you want and find flexible solutions

questions.question_text: What is an effective way to understand the other party’s perspective during a negotiation?

options.text: Assume you know their reasons and push your own agenda
Interrupt them to explain why your side is more important
Ask open-ended questions and actively listen to their concerns
Ignore their feelings to stay focused on your goals

correct_answer.text: Ask open-ended questions and actively listen to their concerns

questions.question_text: What is a key characteristic of a win-win solution in negotiation?

options.text: One party gets everything they want, while the other compromises completely
Both parties feel satisfied because their core interests are addressed
It only works in competitive negotiations where winning is the goal
It avoids any form of compromise to keep things simple

correct_answer.text: Both parties feel satisfied because their core interests are addressed
